digest.component_or_area: operational script for bridge-state history stripping
propositions: Build and test a committed operational script that strips .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from repository history using stock Git fast-export/fast-import plumbing without new dependencies.

The dry-run script must verify on a fresh unfiltered --no-tags clone that rewrite preserves commit and merge-commit counts, maintains DAG topology, produces a byte-identical HEAD tree after dynamic re-add, and measures final pack size at most 150 MB.

The script must refuse to execute in partial blob:none clones, assert the protected remote tag refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z is absent from rewritten clone but unchanged on source remote, and never perform any push operation.

The history-stripping filter must parse commit messages by byte length rather than line-based grepping to correctly distinguish message data from file commands and preserve adversarial messages beginning with 'M ' or 'D ' bytes.
The re-add set for .bridge_state/ files must be derived dynamically from git ls-tree rather than hardcoded, ensuring future .bridge_state/ additions survive the rewrite without script modification.
